bridgeMechanism: Extends org.apache.log4j.Category and delegates logging calls to org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.ExtendedLogger obtained from the active LoggerContext.
behavioralDifferences: Logger.getLogger(String, LoggerFactory) is not supported; use Log4j 2 extension mechanisms instead.
Category.getEffectiveLevel() maps to Logger.getLevel() rather than computing an inherited effective level in all cases.

bridgeMechanism: Wraps an org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger instance and forwards log methods via maybeLog() while preserving Log4j 1 hierarchy and appender attachment semantics.
behavioralDifferences: Category has been deprecated since Log4j 1.2; Logger is the supported Log4j 1 type.
Programmatic setLevel() and appender attachment require log4j1.compatibility=true for full Log4j 1 backend behavior.
deprecationNotes: Category is deprecated; migrate to org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger.

bridgeMechanism: Maintains a Log4j 1 LoggerRepository backed by org.apache.logging.log4j.spi.LoggerContext via org.apache.log4j.Hierarchy.
behavioralDifferences: Default configuration file remains log4j.properties rather than log4j2.xml.
LogManager.shutdown() behavior depends on the logging backend; Log4j Core registers its own shutdown hook.
deprecationNotes: RepositorySelector and Hierarchy APIs are legacy; new code should use org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager directly.

bridgeMechanism: Each org.apache.log4j.Level constant wraps a corresponding org.apache.logging.log4j.Level via the Priority.level2 field.
behavioralDifferences: Log4j 1 Level adds TRACE (since 1.2.12) mapped to org.apache.logging.log4j.Level.TRACE.
Custom Level subclasses create paired org.apache.logging.log4j.Level instances at construction time.

bridgeMechanism: Base class for org.apache.log4j.Level; integer priority values are translated to org.apache.logging.log4j.Level through OptionConverter and Level.toLevel().
behavioralDifferences: Priority is a legacy type; Level should be used instead.
Log4j 2 Level does not expose syslogEquivalent or the Log4j 1 integer level field directly.
deprecationNotes: Refrain from using Priority directly; use org.apache.log4j.Level or org.apache.logging.log4j.Level.

bridgeMechanism: Maintains a local ThreadLocal map and mirrors put/remove/clear operations to org.apache.logging.log4j.ThreadContext.
behavioralDifferences: MDC.put(String, Object) stores the object locally but converts values to String when forwarding to ThreadContext.
MDC.getContext() returns a Hashtable copy rather than the live ThreadContext map.
deprecationNotes: Migrate to org.apache.logging.log4j.ThreadContext for new code.

bridgeMechanism: Delegates stack push/pop/peek operations to org.apache.logging.log4j.ThreadContext stack APIs, converting between java.util.Stack and ThreadContext stack.
behavioralDifferences: NDC uses raw Stack types without generics for source compatibility.
Pattern converter %x in Log4j 2 uses a different default format; use %ndc in the bridge for exact Log4j 1 NDC output.
deprecationNotes: NDC is deprecated in favor of ThreadContext stack operations.

bridgeMechanism: AppenderAdapter.adapt() wraps native Log4j 1 appenders in an AbstractAppender that converts Log4j 2 LogEvent to org.apache.log4j.spi.LoggingEvent via LogEventWrapper.
behavioralDifferences: Log4j 1 appenders without a name receive a synthetic name based on their hash code.
AppenderWrapper provides the reverse mapping when a Log4j 2 appender is referenced from Log4j 1 configuration.
deprecationNotes: Custom appenders should be rewritten as Log4j 2 plugins when possible.

bridgeMechanism: ConsoleAppenderBuilder parses Log4j 1 properties/XML and constructs a Log4j 2 ConsoleAppender wrapped in AppenderWrapper.
behavioralDifferences: Target parameter System.out/System.err maps to ConsoleAppender.Target enum values.
Follow and ImmediateFlush parameters are supported; behavior follows Log4j 2 ConsoleAppender defaults when omitted.

bridgeMechanism: FileAppenderBuilder converts Log4j 1 FileAppender configuration into a Log4j 2 FileAppender with LayoutAdapter for the layout.
behavioralDifferences: Append parameter controls whether the file is opened in append mode.
BufferedIO and buffer size settings may differ from native Log4j 1 FileAppender buffering.

bridgeMechanism: RollingFileAppenderBuilder maps Log4j 1 size-based rolling settings to Log4j 2 RollingFileAppender with SizeBasedTriggeringPolicy.
behavioralDifferences: Log4j 2 default rollover file index strategy differs from Log4j 1; set DefaultRolloverStrategy fileIndex=min for matching behavior.
Implicit filePattern app.%i must be configured explicitly in Log4j 2.

bridgeMechanism: DailyRollingFileAppenderBuilder converts date-based rolling to Log4j 2 RollingFileAppender with TimeBasedTriggeringPolicy.
behavioralDifferences: DatePattern values are translated to Log4j 2 filePattern; verify timezone handling matches expectations.
Log4j 2 uses a different default archived file naming scheme than Log4j 1.

bridgeMechanism: SyslogAppenderBuilder builds a Log4j 2 SyslogAppender; layout conversion uses Log4j1SyslogLayout when a Log4j 1 layout is specified.
behavioralDifferences: Custom layouts on SyslogAppender are not supported in native Log4j 2; the bridge uses Log4j1SyslogLayout for compatibility.
Facility and facilityPrinting parameters map to Log4j 2 SyslogAppender settings with possible formatting differences.

bridgeMechanism: AsyncAppenderBuilder wraps referenced Log4j 1 appenders (via AppenderAdapter) in a Log4j 2 AsyncAppender.
behavioralDifferences: Blocking behavior when the buffer is full follows Log4j 2 AsyncAppender semantics.
LocationInfo (includeLocation) parameter affects whether caller data is captured asynchronously.

bridgeMechanism: SocketAppenderBuilder converts Log4j 1 SocketAppender host/port/reconnection settings to Log4j 2 SocketAppender.
behavioralDifferences: RemoteHost and Port parameters are required; defaults differ from some Log4j 1 versions.
LocationInfo forwarding depends on Log4j 2 serialization of LogEvent over the socket.

bridgeMechanism: LayoutAdapter implements org.apache.logging.log4j.core.Layout by converting Log4j 2 LogEvent to org.apache.log4j.spi.LoggingEvent and calling Layout.format().
behavioralDifferences: LayoutWrapper provides reverse adaptation when a Log4j 2 layout is exposed as a Log4j 1 Layout.
Binary layouts and byte-buffer destinations are not supported by the Log4j 1 Layout interface.
deprecationNotes: Implement org.apache.logging.log4j.core.Layout directly for new components.

bridgeMechanism: PatternLayoutBuilder reads ConversionPattern from Log4j 1 configuration and creates a Log4j 2 PatternLayout wrapped in LayoutWrapper; native org.apache.log4j.PatternLayout uses Log4j 1 PatternParser.
behavioralDifferences: Pattern converters %p, %x, and %X differ between Log4j 1 and Log4j 2; use %v1Level, %ndc, and %properties in the bridge for exact compatibility.
EnhancedPatternLayout is aliased to the same builder as PatternLayout.

bridgeMechanism: configure() calls LogManager.reconfigure() to bootstrap Log4j 2 Core; configure(Appender) attaches an appender to the root logger via the Log4j 1 hierarchy.
behavioralDifferences: BasicConfigurator.configure() no longer hard-codes a ConsoleAppender with TTCC pattern; it triggers standard Log4j 2 auto-configuration.
resetConfiguration() delegates to LogManager.resetConfiguration() on the active hierarchy.
deprecationNotes: Use log4j2.xml or log4j2.properties for production configuration.

bridgeMechanism: Parses log4j.properties and builds a Log4j 2 Configuration via org.apache.log4j.config.PropertiesConfiguration and Log4j1ConfigurationParser when log4j1.compatibility is enabled.
behavioralDifferences: configureAndWatch() requires log4j1.compatibility=true; otherwise a warning is logged and watching is disabled.
Property interpolation uses ${foo} syntax; Log4j 2 requires ${sys:foo} in native configuration files.

bridgeMechanism: When log4j1.compatibility=true, loads log4j.xml via org.apache.log4j.config.XmlConfigurationFactory and applies it through org.apache.logging.log4j.core.config.Configurator.reconfigure().
behavioralDifferences: configure(Element) and parseElement() are no-ops in the bridge implementation.
configureAndWatch() for XML requires log4j1.compatibility=true and uses XMLWatchdog for file monitoring.
deprecationNotes: Convert log4j.xml to log4j2.xml for native Log4j 2 configuration.
